review_candidates.title: Billing Analyst "Fluent English Speaker"
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities: Perform monthly billing discrepancy analysis across multiple telecom vendors and account types, identifying rate mismatches, unauthorized charges, missing services, and billing errors against contracted rates and inventory records. Open, manage, and follow up on vendor disputes through to resolution, maintaining accurate dispute trackers and ensuring all items are progressed within agreed timelines. Maintain and update telecom inventory records (circuits, accounts, service IDs)
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements: Minimum 3 years of experience in telecom billing analysis, billing reconciliation, or a closely related field. Equivalent hands-on experience in telecom billing or financial reconciliation will be considered in lieu of a degree.
